vision.name: Orange Checkup Drill
vision.text:
(Limit 1 per deck. When this Drill enters play during combat, if it is the first time a card titled "Orange Checkup Drill" has entered play this combat you may search your Life Deck for a Styled [Defense] card and place it into your hand.)
[Continuous]: Your attacks deal +1 stage.
[Instant] POWER: Use at the end of combat. Rejuvenate 2.
vision.note: landscape Drill layout; text set in a newer, condensed font; '(FROZEN)' stamped below the card (owner annotation) but the filename has no (Frozen) flag
